products.name: Fathom
products.note: Meeting notetaker AI; auto-summaries; CRM sync; consent and privacy

profile_text.body:
Fathom is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2020 that offers an AI-powered meeting notetaker compatible with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company describes its product as capturing, transcribing, and summarizing calls automatically, with the individual tier available free of charge. For teams, the platform offers AI-generated action items, CRM synchronization, and an "Ask Fathom" search interface that the company says delivers customizable summaries tailored to a team's workflow.

Beyond note-taking, Fathom positions its product around sales and coaching use cases, offering AI Scorecards intended to give managers real-time coaching moments and follow-up metrics. The company says call insights and action items flow automatically into third-party tools without manual updates, and that CRM records are updated while users remain focused on conversations.

Fathom is registered as a public company under SEC CIK 0001753162 with ticker FTHM, verified as of September 2026. The site has 175 California law exposure entries on record. Fathom also maintains a registered MCP server, ai.fathom.api/mcp, described as giving AI assistants real meeting context so that outputs are grounded in a user's actual work.
